name: cairn
description: Typed facts for agents via @quarkos/cairn. Assert, recall, and retract beliefs that outlive the session. Never the unscoped npm package cairn.

CAIRN_HOME.title: Cairn store directory
CAIRN_HOME.description: Absolute path on this machine to your project's .cairn directory after `npx -y @quarkos/cairn init --project`. Optional. Leave unset to use native resolution (CAIRN_HOME if already set, else ./.cairn if present, else ~/.cairn). Not a secret.
